name: Vitor Meireles (Brazil)
description: Green field quartered by two red stripes, charged at their intersection with a white disc bearing the municipal arms.
history: Vitor Meireles is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil, named after the painter Victor Meirelles. Flags of the World records that the flag was prescribed by Municipal Law No. 38 of 23 April 1990: on a green field two perpendicular red stripes quarter the field, with a white circle bearing the municipal arms over their intersection.
